executive_summary: The frontier-39-analysis-30 build is mechanically closed and handed to the owner as publishable-pending-owner-approval: 60 pages and 929 items across fourier-analysis, lie-theory and pde, judge verdicts complete for all 929 items on the configured single-model lineup (recorded as sol61, model gpt-6.1-sol), the proof-layout gates passing over 3515 steps, no terminal resolutions, no deferred pairs or items, no pathway obligations and no workflow-owned blockers. The historical defect record is heavy but dispositioned for the run's own scope: 721 fatal accuracy rows, of which 707 were fixed outright, 1 fixed and later superseded, 9 left open historically but superseded by later owner closure actions, and 1 false positive; the 167 judge rejections were adjudicated as 77 confirmed fatal, 87 confirmed nonfatal and 3 false positive. Two fatal rows remain deferred, both on published items outside the 929-item judged scope - thm-strong-separation-of-closed-and-compact-convex-sets (Statement/Given omit the ambient normed space) and thm-sigma-finite-duality-for-bounded-functionals-on-l-p (the local L^q gluing needs an explicit choice premise or a choice-free argument) - and each needs an owner-authorised published clarification. This interpretation re-verified the packet's internal fingerprint and all eight pinned input hashes; the three remaining owner actions are the personal mathematical audit, the deliberate status:published changes, and push/deployment.
caveats: Two fatal accuracy rows remain 'deferred' and are the only fatal rows without any closure reference: f39-b15-5a-published-ambient on the published thm-strong-separation-of-closed-and-compact-convex-sets (the Statement/Given never declare the ambient real/complex normed space needed for distance, norm balls and X*) and f39-b15-5a-published-gluing on the published thm-sigma-finite-duality-for-bounded-functionals-on-l-p (the gluing of countably many local L^q densities needs an explicit AC premise or a choice-free measurable construction; the item's own finite-measure density supplier assumes AC). The run's batch-15 review receipts record that both proofs are sound for the assigned consumers, which do supply the missing setting or premise, but that the standalone published interfaces remain uncertified until the owner authorises a minimal published clarification; both items are outside the 929-item judged scope, so the run's closed verdict does not cover them.

Judge evidence comes from a single configured model (lineup sol61, model gpt-6.1-sol): 1096 exact verdicts over the version set, 929 kept and 167 rejected, with all 167 rejections adjudicated as 77 confirmed fatal, 87 confirmed nonfatal and 3 false positive, and no mixed, null or incomplete configured sets. Single-lineup coverage cannot exclude correlated blind spots, and per the repository standard coverage is current only for the model set tools/models.mjs resolves; the packet itself still lists the owner's personal mathematical audit as an outstanding owner action.

The defect load is large and concentrated outside proofs: 721 fatal accuracy rows (642 caught at 5a adjudication, 72 at step-7 adjudication, 5 at 7-rejudge, 2 at 7.2-impact), with leading subclasses false-or-overstrong-statement 144, missing-hypothesis 119, invalid-inference 77, citation-inaccurate 59 and missing-choice-scope 53, and leading locations statement 191, proof-step 174 and facts-block 143. Every row is dispositioned (707 fixed, 1 fixed-and-superseded, 9 open-historically-but-superseded, 1 false positive) except the two deferred rows, but the mix is a claim-, hypothesis- and citation-hygiene risk rather than a proof-gap risk.

The packet's 387-item repeated-repairs list is drawn from the shared touch ledger and is library-wide, not frontier-39-specific: sampled entries resolve to items whose frontmatter records pipeline_run frontier-40-geometry-braids-rep-27 (Khovanov-Seidel and canonical-resolution material) alongside this frontier's own items, and the highest counts (4 repairs) belong to those other runs. It should be used as a routing and sampling signal, not read as this frontier's churn count.

Integrity checks performed by this read-only role: the packet's internal fingerprint recomputes to the recorded evidence_sha256 1b95c2f3..., the readiness content_sha256 593f2aee... matches the publication-readiness receipt and verdict, and all eight pinned input hashes match the current on-disk files. The run's own live re-derivation (tools/step9-report.mjs check-evidence) could not execute in this sandbox because it spawns a subprocess that was denied (EPERM), so currency against live receipts rests on the engine's generation plus the hash re-verification above rather than an independent replay here.

The proof-layout gates certify formatting only (proof-step-separation and proof-blue-tags over 3515 steps of 929 items); they are not mathematical evidence. Mathematical soundness rests on the run's adjudication record, the single judge lineup above, and the still-pending owner audit. No publication state was changed by this run: the three remaining owner actions are the personal mathematical audit, the deliberate status:published changes, and push/deployment.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: The two deferred published items: thm-strong-separation-of-closed-and-compact-convex-sets and thm-sigma-finite-duality-for-bounded-functionals-on-l-p
owner_reading_priorities.reason: These are the only fatal accuracy rows without a closure and they sit on published, widely reused interfaces. Each needs a minimal owner-authorised fix (name the ambient normed space; add the explicit choice premise or an authorised choice-free gluing argument), and each fix must be reviewed against its direct consumers, which currently supply the missing setting themselves.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: thm-higher-order-sobolev-embedding and thm-sobolev-embedding-on-bounded-extension-domains-for-p-less-than-n, with the Gagliardo-Nirenberg and weak-derivative cluster
owner_reading_priorities.reason: This family carries the highest recorded fatal counts in the packet, mostly missing-hypothesis and citation rows, and its closures include owner-scoped decisions (for example f39-b13-higher-sobolev-u-scope-owner-closed). Exponent ranges and the exact cited statements are precisely where a surviving reader-facing error would hide.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: thm-poincare-inequality-for-w-one-p-zero and the missing-choice-scope cluster (53 fatal rows)
owner_reading_priorities.reason: That statement's choice premise was closed only through a dedicated owner action (f39-owner-poincare-choice-closed), and several neighbouring items assume AC/CC silently. Confirm that the final statement text carries the premise that the proof and the cited Sobolev/measure interfaces actually use, on both sides of the iff-style interfaces.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: The 167 adjudicated judge rejections, especially the 87 confirmed_nonfatal outcomes and the 3 false positives
owner_reading_priorities.reason: They calibrate the single-lineup judge and record where the run repaired confirmed nonfatal defects anyway and where it overruled the judge on evidence (for example the false-positive title of lem-gaussian-decay-gives-an-entire-fourier-laplace-transform). Sampling a handful directly tests the standard's no-unnecessary-edit discipline on both sides.

owner_reading_priorities.subject: Items repaired more than once within this frontier, and the corrected page prose (43 fatal page-prose rows plus page summaries and titles)
owner_reading_priorities.reason: Repeated repairs mark statements contested across rounds, so their final text should be read as a whole rather than as a diff; and page prose is what readers actually see first. Several fatal rows were page-level overstrong claims (for example in the Poisson-summation and sampling pages), so the corrected summaries deserve a direct read.

recommendations.recommendation: Resolve the two deferred published defects through the published-change protocol as two minimal, separately reviewable clarifications: add the ambient real/complex normed-space hypothesis to the separation theorem's Statement/Given, and add the explicit choice premise (or an authorised choice-free gluing argument) to the sigma-finite duality theorem, reviewing each item's direct consumers for impact.
recommendations.impact: Removes the only two open fatal accuracy findings, closes the last uncertified published interfaces touched by this frontier, and keeps the already-sound downstream consumers sound.
